entries.misread: You can only attack if you moved this turn.
entries.actual_rule: Move and attack are both optional; attack comes after move if you do both.
fix_suggestions: "On your turn you may move, then you may attack. You can attack without moving."
Add a turn-order strip to the player aid: MOVE (optional) → ATTACK (optional).

entries.misread: Storms last until someone remembers to remove them.
entries.actual_rule: Storms expire at the end of the round after they were placed.
fix_suggestions: Place the storm token on the round track at its expiry round.
